executor_profile.justification: Bounded but cross-cutting coverage-detection machinery spanning saga/team-execution/mission-control script trees; a false-negative in the coverage guards would defeat the issue's purpose and a green test suite alone would not catch it, so team-execution consensus review is warranted over plain inline execution. No external-LLM chaperone dispatch needed, consistent with {#external-engines-never-gatekeepers}. Effort is target posture: not a live team-execution dispatch knob until pf-effort-first-class lands; teammates inherit session tier until then.
